decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that extends the firm's established automation offer in a growing, investment-oriented business, it is unlikely to be withdrawn so quickly without signs of market failure.

This dual-table loading system fits the firm's core machining and productivity proposition, so a German machinery producer with broad portfolio and service capability would normally keep developing rather than exit it after one year.

Although it is more distant from the firm's historic offer, it was presented as a flagship direction and already received visible recognition, which strongly supports continued market presence despite somewhat higher strategic risk.
